steps.en: Owners whose 3rd reminder is due are picked for the letter run
steps.id: Pemilik yang jatuh tempo reminder ke-3 dipilih untuk pembuatan letter

steps.en: A data file for the 3rd reminder letters is built for the print vendor
steps.id: File data untuk letter reminder ke-3 dibuat untuk vendor cetak

steps.en: The file goes to the print vendor over a secure transfer
steps.id: File dikirim ke vendor cetak lewat transfer aman
steps.why_en: Sending to the print vendor is switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor cetak dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.

steps.en: Once sent, the notice moves to its next stage and the owner counts as informed
steps.id: Setelah terkirim, notice pindah ke tahap berikutnya dan pemilik dianggap sudah diberi tahu
steps.why_en: While sending is blocked the notice still moves on, though no letter was delivered.
steps.why_id: Selama pengiriman diblok notice tetap pindah tahap, padahal letter belum terkirim.
